title: Fravor and Dietrich disagree on how long the encounter lasted

tellings.quote: Dietri says her experience only lasted five, sorry, 8 to 10 seconds. the entire thing from merge plot to the thing flying away,

plain: In 2004, two Navy fighter pilots, David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, flew together toward a strange object off Southern California, and they are said to remember the encounter lasting different lengths of time. Mick West, a well-known skeptic who analyses UFO videos, tells Michels that Dietrich says her whole experience, from first approach to the object flying away, lasted only 8 to 10 seconds. He sets her account against Fravor's, which he treats as longer. It matters because the shorter the encounter, the less the pilots could have taken in.
